decisions: Swap UI uses a compact sell/receive card and searchable token directory inspired by the user's Jupiter reference, while retaining SYMBaiEX forum colors, existing Dialog/Button primitives, responsive layout and explicit transaction review.

Trading terminal uses the user's Birdeye reference as a composition guide: a full-width connected analytical pane, persistent order column, compact asset/metric strips and a sortable sampled-market table. Retain forum navigation, Geist typography and magenta/teal identity, real source freshness and mounted protected receipts. Do not copy branding or invent trader rankings, order books or unsupported controls.

The trading terminal is a route-local viewport workspace below the shared site header, not a long document. Desktop uses flexible analytical space, a persistent 328px independently scrolling execution pane, and an expandable lower tools drawer. At a root workspace width of 840px or less, a single safe-area-aware dock reveals mounted Chart, Markets, Trade, Receipts and Tools views. Wallet/watches, research, community and treasury remain reachable without recreating financial controllers. Show known private protection counts from existing receipts outside hidden panes, never infer all operations are clear. Keep source age, financial consent and 44px touch targets readable; hide the global footer/mobile forum nav only after the valid enabled website workspace mounts.

Refine sampled markets with an actual returned-result count, an always-reachable sort control, explicit stale text beside the sticky mint, and an associated horizontal-scroll hint. Empty-result recovery changes only existing filter state, never adds a refresh path. Keep timestamps, raw numeric titles and the nine-column table intact. Group terminal tools into account, research/community and transparency lists, with internal chevrons, short descriptions, visible All tools navigation and receipt-specific guest guidance.
